disclosure: Response-time figures reflect widely cited industry research on lead response times, not Black Arrow's own client data.

claims.text: Fewer than 20% of service businesses respond to a new lead within the first hour.
Responding within five minutes significantly improves the odds of closing a lead compared to waiting thirty minutes, based on widely cited industry research.
Speed to lead, lead-to-booked rate, and show-up rate compound, so tracking only one hides problems in the others.
